svg.title: Parameters and near-threshold margins control abstention
svg.desc: Coupling-bound undecided percentages in each predeclared parameter regime, 288 pairs per cell. Lower-panel bins describe the saved reference peak's distance to its threshold; they are descriptive, not a change to the frozen thresholds. Empty bins remain missing, not zero failures.
svg.title: Parameters and near-threshold margins control abstention

ns2:Work.dc:title: Parameters and near-threshold margins control abstention
ns2:Work.dc:description: Coupling-bound undecided percentages in each predeclared parameter regime, 288 pairs per cell. Lower-panel bins describe the saved reference peak's distance to its threshold; they are descriptive, not a change to the frozen thresholds. Empty bins remain missing, not zero failures.
